blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features.
We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer.
Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights.
These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning.
Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment.
SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone.
On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024–2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively.
At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods.
These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR.
The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO .

我们通过半事实上的即时干预来调查这种敏感性,这种干预维护了根本问题及其答案。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has advanced the development of large language models (LLMs) with strong reasoning capabilities, such as OpenAI o1 ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) .
Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , a representative RLVR method, optimizes automatically checkable outcomes without process-level supervision.
Recent evidence suggests that RLVR can diminish dependence on spurious correlations and improve generalization under distribution shifts ( Fu et al., 2026 ) .
However, robustness evaluations still reveal sensitivity to irrelevant information and input perturbations ( Mirzadeh et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
Understanding how training factors affect generalization in RLVR and how to further improve it remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)推动了具有强大推理能力的大型语言模型(LLM)的发展,如OpenAI o1(OpenAI,2024)和DeepSeek-R1(Guo等人,2025).
集团相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等人,2024年),一种具有代表性的RLVR方法,在不进行流程级监管的情况下,可自动优化可核查结果.
最近的证据表明,RLVR可以减少对虚假关联的依赖,并在分配转移时改善通俗化(Fu等人,2026年)。
然而,稳健性评价仍然显示出对无关信息和投入扰动的敏感性(Mirzadeh等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年)。
了解培训因素如何影响RLVR的普及,如何进一步改进,仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en:
We study spurious dependence in RLVR at the token level.
Building on prior studies of spurious feature reliance ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) , we probe causal invariance ( Peters et al., 2016 ; Arjovsky et al., 2019 ) in LLM inference through semifactual prompt interventions ( Goodman, 1947 ; Lu et al., 2022 ) .
Specifically, we alter task-irrelevant prompt features while preserving the mathematical problem and its answer, using drift in the token probabilities of a fixed response as a proxy for potential spurious dependence.
We find that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves the accuracy of Qwen3-4B-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) from 15.8% to 30.0% on a 1,000-question mathematical diagnostic panel without updating model weights (see Section 2 ).
The above results suggest that LLMs are highly sensitive to token-level spurious features.
However, GRPO assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every valid token in a response, without directly accounting for this token-level sensitivity.
As a result, positive outcome credit may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们研究RLVR中虚伪的依赖性
根据先前对假特征依赖的研究(Wang等人,2022年;Fu等人,2026年),我们通过半事实即时干预(Goodman,1947年;Lu等人,2022年)在LLM推论中探寻因果变化(Peters等人,2016年;Arjovsky等人,2019年)。
具体地说,我们改变与任务无关的即时特征,同时保留数学问题及其答案,将固定反应的象征性概率中的漂移作为潜在虚假依赖的代名词.
我们发现,在解码过程中压制高驱动符号候选人可以提高Qune3-4B-Base(Yang等人,2025年)在1 000个问题数学诊断面板上的准确度,从15.8%提高到30.0%,而不更新模型权重(见第2节)。
上述结果表明,有限责任公司对象征性的虚假特征高度敏感。
然而,GRPO在答复中为每个有效标志赋予相同的结果衍生优势,而不直接说明这种标志级别的敏感性.
因此,正面结果信贷可能加强潜在的虚假依赖和有用的推理。

blocks.en:
To address the above problem, one intuitive way is to change the RL training process, incorporating semifactual sensitivity into token-level credit assignment.
In this paper, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO) , a causally inspired variant of GRPO that aims to turn semifactual stability into a token-level credit signal during training.
This signal reveals differences in token sensitivity that final-answer correctness alone cannot distinguish.
Verifiable rewards provide response-level supervision, while semifactual stability refines token-level credit assignment.
blocks.zh:
为了解决上述问题,一种直观的方法是改变RL培训过程,将半事实敏感性纳入象征性的信贷分配。
在本文中,我们介绍了半事实信用强化政策优化(SCAPO),这是GRPO的一个因果启发的变体,其目的是在培训期间将半事实稳定性转化为象征性的信用信号.
这一信号揭示了符号灵敏度的差异,仅最后的答案正确性是无法区分的.
可核实的奖励提供响应层面的监督,而半事实稳定性则完善了象征层面的信用分配.

blocks.en:
In particular, SCAPO uses the rollout policy to teacher-force each sampled response under the original prompt and its semifactual perturbations, measuring the probability drifts of each response token.
After aggregating and normalizing these drifts within each prompt group, it adds only the negative part of the resulting stability score to the GRPO advantage as a detached token-level credit augmentation.
Consequently, relatively unstable tokens receive lower advantages, while stability alone earns no additional credit, since stability does not imply correctness.
We apply this credit augmentation during the early phase of training to shape trajectory selection, then continue optimizing the resulting policy with standard GRPO.
blocks.zh:
特别是,SCAPO将推出政策用于在原始即时及其半事实扰动下对每个抽样反应进行教师强制,测量每个响应符的概率漂移.
在汇总和规范每个提示组内的这些漂移后,它只将由此产生的稳定性分数的负部分加到GRPO的优势上,作为独立的代号级信用增益.
因此,相对不稳定的征兆获得的优势较低,而仅靠稳定就得不到额外信贷,因为稳定并不意味着正确。
在培训的早期阶段,我们采用这种信贷增益办法,确定轨迹选择,然后继续以标准GPRO优化由此产生的政策。

blocks.en:
SCAPO improves AIME 2024–2026 accuracy ( Mathematical Association of America, 2026 ) over GRPO by +5.63 and +4.17 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , respectively.
As shown in Figure 1 , SCAPO reaches GRPO’s final AIME accuracy in fewer than half as many policy optimization steps.
Moreover, across both model scales, SCAPO outperforms GRPO on all evaluated benchmarks and achieves the best performance on most of the competition-level mathematics benchmarks among all the compared RLVR methods.
SCAPO also achieves the highest accuracy on out-of-distribution benchmarks at both model scales.
In addition, our ablations further support the value of aligning credit corrections with semifactual sensitivity and selectively reducing credit for relatively unstable tokens.
These results suggest that semifactual stability complements outcome rewards with an effective signal for finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR.
blocks.zh:
SCAPO在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-1.7B-Base(杨等人,2025年)上分别以+5.63和+4.17的分数提高AIME 2024–2026准确度(美国数学协会,2026年).
如图1所示,SCAPO在不到一半的政策优化步骤中达到GRPO的最终AIME精度.
此外,在两个模型中,SCAPO在所有评估的基准上都超过了GPRO,在所有比较的RLVR方法中,在大多数竞争级数学基准上都取得了最佳成绩。
SCAPO还实现了两个模型比额表中分配外基准的最高精确度.
此外,我们进一步支持按照半事实敏感性调整信用更正,有选择地减少相对不稳定的征兆的信用的价值。
这些结果表明,半事实稳定性通过在RLVR中提供更精细的信贷分配的有效信号来补充结果奖励。

blocks.en:
Our contributions can be summarized as: • We study token-level spurious dependence in LLM inference through semifactual prompt interventions, revealing heterogeneous sensitivity and showing that suppressing high-drift tokens during decoding can improve reasoning accuracy without weight updates. (Sec. 2 ) • We introduce SCAPO , an approach to token-level credit augmentation in GRPO using detached negative-only corrections derived from fixed-response semifactual stability, without requiring process supervision or an external reward model. (Sec. 3 ) • We empirically demonstrate SCAPO’s effectiveness on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, achieving the best results on most benchmarks among the compared RLVR methods.
These results show that semifactual stability can serve as an effective training-time signal for token-level credit assignment in RLVR. (Sec. 4 )

blocks.en:
We probe potential token-level spurious dependence with semifactual sensitivity.
Using a frozen base model, we characterize how this sensitivity varies across tokens and then examine whether suppressing unstable token candidates improves decoding.

blocks.en:
Semifactual perturbations alter incidental features of a prompt while preserving its underlying mathematical problem and final answer ( Kenny and Keane, 2021 ) .
Following prior work on reasoning robustness under input perturbations ( Mirzadeh et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) , we construct four types of perturbations: paraphrase, minor typo noise, irrelevant scenario wrapping, and appended irrelevant context.
We use GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) to generate these perturbations, instructing it to preserve quantities, mathematical expressions, constraints, and the requested quantity.

跟踪先前在输入扰动下关于推理稳健性的工作 (Mirzadeh等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年),我们构建了四类扰动:释义,小打字噪音,无关情景包装,以及附加的无关上下文.
我们使用GPT-5.5(OpenAI,2026)生成这些扰动,指示它保存数量,数学表达,约束,以及请求的数量.

blocks.en:
To test whether this semifactual sensitivity signal can help improve reasoning accuracy, we evaluate Qwen3-4B-Base under standard sampling and an online d d -filtered decoding strategy on the same 1,000 selected questions.
Specifically, at each decoding step, we compute drift for every candidate token in the vocabulary, rank non-EOS candidates in descending drift order, and mask the longest prefix whose cumulative probability mass does not exceed 0.8.
We always retain the EOS token, and then renormalize the remaining probabilities.
With model weights unchanged, accuracy rises from 15.8% to 30.0% (+14.2 points), as shown in Figure 3 .
This result demonstrates that semifactual sensitivity provides an actionable token-level signal and motivates its use for finer-grained credit assignment during RLVR training.
More details and additional results are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
为了测试这个半事实灵敏信号能否帮助提高推理精度,我们在标准采样下评价Quen3-4B-Base,并在同一个1000个选定问题上评价在线d-filtered解码策略.
具体来说,在每个解码步骤上,我们计算词汇中每个候选符号的漂移,按照递降漂移顺序对非EOS候选者进行排序,并遮盖最长的前缀,其累积概率质量不超过0.8.
我们总是保留EOS符号,然后将剩余的概率恢复正常.
在模型加权不变的情况下,精度从15.8%上升到30.0%(+14.2分),如图3所示.

blocks.en: 3 Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
blocks.zh: 3 半事实信用强化政策优化

blocks.en:
Building on the decoding benefit of suppressing unstable token candidates, we use semifactual stability to probe potential spurious dependence and refine token-level credit assignment during RLVR training.
Our guiding principle is to reduce the advantages assigned to relatively unstable tokens without granting additional credit for stability alone, since stability does not imply correctness.
In this section, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a GRPO-based algorithm that combines trajectory-level outcome advantages with token-level semifactual stability for finer-grained credit assignment.
Figure 4 presents an overview of SCAPO, which consists of semifactual prompt intervention, token probability drift probing, relative stability signal construction, and policy optimization with GRPO advantages augmented by the semifactual credit signal.

在压制不稳定信使候选人的解码利益的基础上,我们利用半事实稳定性来探寻潜在的虚假依赖,并在RLVR训练期间完善信使级信用分配.
我们的指导原则是,减少分配给相对不稳定的象征物的好处,而不只是为稳定提供额外的信贷,因为稳定并不意味着正确。
在本节中,我们介绍了半事实信用强化政策优化(SCAPO),这是一种基于GRPO的算法,将轨迹级结果优势与象征级半事实稳定性相结合,用于更精细的信用分配.
图4概述了SCAPO,它包括半事实即时干预,符号概率漂移探测,相对稳定性信号构建,以及政策优化与GRPO优势,半事实信用信号强化.

(d) The scaled stability correction, with gradients stopped, is added to the GRPO advantage to produce token-level advantages for policy optimization.

blocks.en:
We train on DAPO-Math-17K ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , a curated dataset of approximately 17,000 competition-level mathematics problems with integer answers.

blocks.en:
We consider the following representative RLVR methods:
(1) GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) : computes group-relative advantages from outcome rewards and applies token-level clipped policy updates.
(2) GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) : uses sequence-level importance ratios and clipping for policy optimization.
(3) SAPO ( Gao et al., 2025b ) : replaces hard clipping with smooth, advantage-dependent gating.
(4) CF-GRPO ( Khandoga et al., 2026 ) : estimates token-level credit through counterfactual masking of reasoning spans.
(5) FIPO ( Ma et al., 2026 ) : reweights token advantages using discounted future KL.
At each model scale, comparisons match the training data, reward function, prompt template, optimizer, rollout settings, training-step budget, and evaluation protocol.
Method-specific hyperparameters are provided in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们认为具有代表性的RLVR方法如下:
(1)GRPO(Shao等人,2024年):从结果奖励中计算集团关系优势,并应用符号级剪切政策更新.
(2)普惠制O(郑等人,2025年):采用序列级重要性比率和剪辑方式优化政策.
(3) SAPO(Gao等人,2025年b):用光滑,依赖优势的吉他代替硬剪辑.
(4) CF-GRPO(Khandoga等人,2026年):通过反事实掩盖推理跨度来估计象征性信用。
(5) FIPO(Ma等人,2026年):使用折扣的未来KL重新加权符号优势.
在每个模型尺度上,比较匹配培训数据,奖励功能,即时模板,优化器,推出设置,培训步骤预算,以及评价协议.
附录E.1提供了特定方法的超参数。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that SCAPO improves over GRPO on all eight mathematical reasoning metrics at both model scales.
AIME accuracy increases by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points on the 4B and 1.7B models, respectively, while HMMT improves by 4.46 and 2.98 points.
SCAPO achieves the highest accuracy on six of eight metrics at 4B and all eight at 1.7B, with the highest average accuracy at both scales.
Additional results show that SCAPO achieves the highest Pass@128 on AIME and AMC at both model scales (see Appendix F.2 ).
blocks.zh:
表1显示,SCAPO在两个模型尺度的所有八个数学推理度量表上都比GRPO有所改进.
AIME精度在4B型和1.7B型机上分别提高了5.63和4.17个百分点,而HMMT则提高了4.46和2.98个百分点.
SCAPO在8个公尺中的6个在4B,所有8个在1.7B,都实现了最高的精度,两个尺度的平均精度最高.
其他结果显示,SCAPO在AIME和AMC两个模型中都实现了最高的Pass@128(见附录F.2)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Overall accuracy on competition-level mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution benchmarks (%). Base denotes the model before RL. AIME variants aggregate 2024–2026, while HMMT and AMC aggregate 2025–2026 and 2023–2025, respectively. Year-specific results are provided in Appendix F.1 . Bold and underline indicate the best and second-best results, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:竞争一级数学推理和分配外基准的总体准确性(%)。 Base在RL前表示模型. AIME的变种总计2024–2026,而HMMT和AMC分别是2025–2026和2023–2025. 附录F.1提供了具体年份的结果。 粗体和下划线分别表明最佳和次佳成果。

blocks.en:
SCAPO achieves the highest accuracy on all three out-of-distribution benchmarks at both model scales (Table 1 ).
On GPQA-Diamond, accuracy improves over GRPO from 36.26% to 42.45% at 4B and from 27.42% to 31.25% at 1.7B, gains of 6.19 and 3.83 percentage points, respectively.
Together with the improvements on NoOp-AIME and ThinkBench-AIME, these results show that the gains extend to both perturbed mathematical problems and scientific reasoning beyond the training domain.
blocks.zh:
SCAPO在两个模型比额表的所有三个分配基准中都实现了最高准确度(表1)。
在GPQA-Diamond上,4B的GRPO精度从36.26%提高到42.45%,1.7B的精度从27.42%提高到31.25%,分别提高了6.19%和3.83个百分点.
这些结果,加上NoOp-AIME和Think Bench-AIME的改进,表明这些收益既包括扰动的数学问题,也包括培训领域以外的科学推理。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate the source and sign of token-level credit to examine their roles in SCAPO’s performance gains, and the results are shown in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们放弃象征性信用的来源和标志,以审查它们在SCAPO业绩收益中的作用,结果见表2。

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablations on Qwen3-1.7B-Base. SCAPO uses negative-only corrections.
blocks.zh: 表2: Qwen3-1.7B-Base上的误差. SCAPO只使用负修正.

blocks.en:
The random shuffle ablation permutes semifactual corrections within each response, preserving their values but breaking the original token alignment.
The counterfactual ablation replaces answer-preserving semifactual prompts with answer-changing perturbations, while keeping the credit construction unchanged.
SCAPO performs best on the five competition-level benchmarks, followed consistently by random shuffle and the counterfactual control.
On AIME 24–26, SCAPO leads these controls by 3.55 and 5.56 percentage points, respectively.
These results support aligning credit with semifactual sensitivity, since drift under answer-changing perturbations may reflect legitimate changes in token predictions rather than spurious dependence.
blocks.zh:
随机的洗涤精华在每个响应中进行半事实上的校正,保留了它们的值但打破了原来的符号对齐.
反事实膨胀用改变答案的扰动取代了保留答案的半事实提示,同时保持信用构建不变.
SCAPO在五个竞争级别基准方面表现最好,其次是随机洗牌和反事实控制。
在AIME 24–26上,SCAPO领导这些控制分别领先3.55和5.56个百分点.
这些结果有助于使信用与半事实敏感性相一致,因为因答案变化而漂移的扰动可能反映象征预测的合理变化,而不是虚假的依赖。

blocks.en:
We compare negative-only, all-sign, and positive-only corrections by retaining negative, all, or positive stability scores.
SCAPO’s negative-only correction achieves the highest average accuracy across the five competition-level benchmarks.
This supports reducing credit for relatively unstable tokens without rewarding stability alone.
blocks.zh:
我们通过保留负面、全部或正面稳定分数来比较只有负面、全信号和只有正面的更正。
SCAPO的负唯一更正在五个竞争级别基准中达到了最高平均准确度.
这有助于减少对相对不稳定的象征物的信贷,而不仅仅奖励稳定。

blocks.en: 4.4 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 计算效率

blocks.en: Figure 5: Training time breakdown of SCAPO on Qwen3-4B-Base. Other includes validation, reward computation, old policy log-probability computation, and miscellaneous overhead.
blocks.zh: 图5:Qwen3-4B-Base上的SCAPO的培训时间细目。 其他包括验证、奖励计算、旧的政策日志概率计算和杂项间接费用。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 5 , semifactual probing and credit construction account for only 1.8% of the measured training runtime in the 4B experiment, far less than autoregressive rollout.
The probes reuse sampled responses through teacher forcing, avoiding fresh generation under each perturbed prompt.
They are also confined to the initial credit augmentation phase and incur no further cost during subsequent optimization.
Together, these properties keep probing a small fraction of total runtime despite evaluating multiple prompts.
Training efficiency is therefore more strongly affected by major stages such as autoregressive generation, whose cost depends on response length.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,半事实检验和信用建设只占4B实验中测量的培训运行时间的1.8%,远低于自动推出.
探测器通过教师强迫对反应进行再利用取样,避免在每个扰动的瞬间下产生新生.
它们也局限于最初的信贷增资阶段,并在随后的优化过程中不再产生任何费用。
这些属性加在一起,尽管评价了多个提示,但仍在总运行时间的一小部分进行检测.
因此,培训效率受到诸如自动生成等主要阶段的更大影响,其成本取决于响应时间。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
RLVR has advanced mathematical reasoning by optimizing automatically verifiable outcomes, with critic-free group-relative methods enabling direct RL training of base models ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2025 ) .
Subsequent work improves normalization and sampling ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , adapts importance weighting and clipping ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025b ) , and promotes exploration through entropy control or off-policy guidance ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) .
However, response-level advantages remain too coarse to distinguish individual reasoning tokens.
Studies of reasoning-path coverage further distinguish improved sampling efficiency from expansion of a model’s reasoning repertoire ( Yue et al., 2025 ) .
Like prior RLVR methods, our approach optimizes verifiable outcome rewards, but leverages semifactual stability to refine credit assignment at the token level.
blocks.zh:
RLVR通过优化自动可核查的结果,推进了数学推理,采用无评论的团体关系方法,使得能够直接对基础模型进行RL培训(Shao等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;Zeng等人,2025年)。
随后的工作改善了正常化和采样(刘等人,2025年;余等人,2025年),调整了重要性加权和剪切(郑等人,2025年;高高等人,2025年b),并通过肽控制或非政策指导促进勘探(崔等人,2025年;颜等人,2025年).
然而,反应层面的优点仍然过于粗糙,无法区分个别推理符号。
对推理-路径覆盖面的研究进一步区分了提高取样效率与扩大模型推理系列(Yue等人,2025年)。
与以前的RLVR方法一样,我们的方法优化了可核查的结果回报,但利用半事实稳定性来完善象征性的信用分配.

blocks.en:
Fine-grained feedback can be learned from process annotations or outcome labels ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) , or estimated through Monte Carlo rollouts ( Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) .
Token entropy, confidence, eligibility traces, and future policy divergence also guide token selection and weighting ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Mou et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
Perturbation- and gradient-based attribution methods estimate how reasoning tokens or spans contribute to final-answer predictions, providing signals for selective supervised fine-tuning and importance-weighted policy updates ( Ruan et al., 2025 ; Khandoga et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Like prior work on fine-grained credit assignment, we use token-level signals to guide policy updates.
Our contribution is to derive negative-only advantage corrections from the sensitivity of a fixed response to semifactual prompt interventions, using teacher-forced token probabilities rather than output-side attribution through span masking or continuation regeneration.
blocks.zh:
精细的反馈可以从过程说明或结果标签中吸取(Lightman等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;Cui等人,2026年),或通过Monte Carlo推出估计(Kazemnejad等人,2025年)。
Token entropy,信心,资格痕迹,以及未来政策差异也指导着符号选择和权重(Wang等人,2025b;Xie等人,2026;Mou等人,2026;Ma等人,2026).
基于扰动和梯度的归属方法估计推理符号或跨度如何有助于最后的答案预测,为选择性监督的微调和重要性加权政策更新提供信号(Ruan等人,2025年;Khandoga等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年)。
与之前的精细信贷分配工作一样,我们使用象征性信号指导政策更新。
我们的贡献是从对半事实即时干预的固定反应的敏感性,利用教师强迫的象征性概率,而不是通过遮盖或持续再生来对产出方面进行归属,得出只有负面优势的纠正。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SCAPO, a causally inspired approach for finer-grained token credit assignment in RLVR.
By probing potential token-level spurious dependence through fixed-response sensitivity to semifactual prompt interventions, SCAPO applies negative-only corrections to GRPO advantages, selectively reducing credit for relatively unstable tokens.
Across Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO outperforms GRPO on all reported benchmark metrics and achieves the best results on most benchmarks among the compared RLVR methods.
These results highlight that semifactual interventions can serve not only as diagnostic probes of brittle reasoning but also as training signals that complement outcome rewards.
Future work will explore this credit augmentation in larger models, more diverse architectures, and domains beyond mathematical reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了SCAPO,这是在RLVR对更精细的象征性信贷分配的一种因果激励方法。
SCAPO通过通过对半事实即时干预的固定反应敏感度来探究潜在的象征级虚假依赖,对GRPO的优势应用了只负修正,有选择地减少了相对不稳定的象征的信用.
纵横 Quen3-4B-Base 和 Quen3-1.7B-Base , SCAPO 超效 关于所有报告的基准衡量标准的全球绩效评估,并在比较的RLVR方法中的大多数基准方面取得最佳结果。
这些结果突出表明,半事实性干预不仅可作为对简单推理的诊断探针,而且可作为补充结果回报的培训信号。
今后的工作将在更大的模型、更加多样化的架构和数学推理以外的领域探索这种信用增益。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
Our training experiments are limited to mathematical reasoning with dense Qwen3 models of 1.7B and 4B parameters trained on DAPO-Math-17K.
Although GPQA-Diamond provides evidence of transfer to scientific reasoning, the effectiveness of SCAPO at larger model and data scales and with broader training domains remains to be evaluated.
Future work should also examine other architectures, including mixture-of-experts (MoE) and hybrid models.
blocks.zh:
我们的训练实验仅限于数学推理,其密集的Quen3模型有1.7B和4B参数,训练于DAPO-Math-17K.
虽然GPQA-Diamond提供了向科学推理转移的证据,但SCAPO在更大的模型和数据规模以及更广泛的培训领域的有效性仍有待评估.
今后的工作还应审查其他结构,包括专家混合模型和混合模型。

blocks.en: System prompt Given a math problem and its original answer, produce exactly 4 prompt perturbations. Core requirements: - Preserve the same mathematical problem. - Preserve all numeric values exactly as written. - Preserve all constraints, operations, requested quantity, and the original answer. - Produce exactly one perturbation for each perturbation_type: paraphrase, typo_noise, scenario_wrap, irrelevant_context. - Do not add any condition that helps solve the problem. - Do not solve the problem. - Do not reveal reasoning. - Return JSON only. Math and LaTeX preservation: - Treat all math expressions as frozen text. This includes text inside $...$, $$...$$, \(...\), \[...\], and standalone symbolic expressions such as variables, equations, inequalities, fractions, powers, percentages, and units. - Do not rewrite, reorder, escape, unescape, or modify any LaTeX/math content. - Preserve every LaTeX command exactly as it appears in the original parsed string: examples include \sin, \angle, \frac, \sqrt, \triangle, \overline. - In JSON, escape backslashes correctly so that the parsed string contains exactly one backslash before each LaTeX command. Never output doubled LaTeX commands like \\sin, and never output raw control characters such as tab or form feed. - Do not alter variables, point labels, entity labels, numbers, units, comparison signs, operations, or answer format. Type-specific requirements: - paraphrase: Rewrite only the natural-language prose that sits outside math expressions. Keep the same scenario, the same entities, the same event and causal order, and every mathematical fact unchanged. Do not introduce a new setting or new objects. - typo_noise: Introduce exactly one character-level edit (insert, delete, substitute, or swap two adjacent characters) in one ordinary English word. The chosen word must NOT be math, LaTeX, a variable, a number, a unit, a proper name, a label, or a mathematical keyword such as "mean", "median", "integer", "prime", "even", "odd". The perturbed text must differ from the original by at least that one non-whitespace character; whitespace-only differences are invalid. The word must still be recognizable to a human reader. - scenario_wrap: Add a light scenario frame around the original problem. This can be a short prefix, a short suffix, or one brief background phrase inserted into the natural-language part of the problem. This should be a small irrelevant context shift, not a full rewrite into a new domain. Keep the original people, objects, quantities, units, formulas, variables, constraints, operations, event order, and requested quantity unchanged. Do not replace core entities or items. Do not change "clips" into "packages", "wallet" into "sensor kit", "flowers" into "crates", or a person into a machine. Good examples: * "At a school craft booth, [original problem]" * "During a budgeting exercise, [original problem]" * "While tracking a reading plan, [original problem]" * "[Original first sentence] This is part of a classroom activity. [remaining original problem]" * "[Original problem] This was recorded in a simple daily log." * "[Original problem] The setting is an ordinary after-school situation." Bad examples: * Rewriting the full story into a different domain. * Replacing the actors or objects with different actors or objects. * Adding hints, extra facts, new conditions, or solution-relevant context. * Adding numbers, formulas, variables, quantities, or mathematical facts. - irrelevant_context: Keep the original problem text exactly unchanged. Append exactly one short meaningless distractor at the very end (after the final question mark or full stop). Acceptable distractor shapes (pick one; vary the shape and content across samples): * A vacuous logical tautology, e.g. "and true is true", "note that 1 = 1", "recall that each thing equals itself". * A short random alphanumeric string of length 6 to 12 characters, e.g. "5XeflW1ZJc", "qP7mz39a". * A bracketed decorative tag, e.g. "[tag: mx93q]", "[marker-a7f]". The distractor MUST NOT contain: * Any mathematical fact, quantity, variable, unit, equation, or operator that could interact with the problem. * Any hint about the problem, the subject area, or the solution approach. * Any statement about the characters, objects, or scenario that appear in the problem. * Any framing or meta-language such as "question", "problem", "exercise", "consider", "observe", "for practice", "simple", "word problem". Return this JSON shape: { "perturbations": [ { "perturbed_question": "...", "perturbation_type": "paraphrase | typo_noise | scenario_wrap | irrelevant_context" } ] }

Frozen Qwen3-4B-Base generates one response per original prompt, with temperature 1.0, top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 , and a limit of 8,192 response tokens.
We then teacher-force the same response tokens under the original prompt and all four perturbed prompts.

blocks.en:
We assign each decoded response token to one of the eight mutually exclusive categories in Table 4 .
Reflection markers are identified using a 16-entry lexicon adapted from prior work ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and our generation traces.
Discourse connectives are identified using 80 single-part DiMLex-Eng forms that contain no whitespace ( Das et al., 2018 ) .
Lexical matching ignores case, surrounding whitespace, and edge punctuation, with reflection markers taking precedence over discourse connectives.

Figures 6 and 7 illustrate two cases with their original and perturbed prompts.

blocks.en:
At each decoding step, we compute the mean bounded-symmetric drift of every vocabulary token across the four perturbed prompts.
We sort all token candidates by decreasing drift.
We mask token candidates in this order until adding the next candidate would exceed the mass cap.
The EOS token is always retained.
The cap limits the total probability mass removed, not the fraction of tokens masked.

我们按这个顺序掩盖象征性候选人 直到下一个候选人超过质量上限
EOS令牌始终保留.
